description: A schema-driven dashboard above the grid in the SvGrid Studio stack. SvSchemaDashboard renders a declarative DashboardSpec of KPI tiles with count, sum and avg and charts through SvSchemaChart, all over the same EntitySchema and data source as the grid. It is a data view rather than a page builder: click a chart category to drill the grid, and creating, editing or deleting a row updates the KPIs and charts.

faq.question: What goes in a DashboardSpec?
faq.answer: An array of tiles, each a KPI with a measure and a reducer or a chart with a group field and a measure. The dashboard lays them out and asks the data source's getAggregate for the numbers.

faq.question: Does the dashboard need its own data?
faq.answer: No. It receives the same schema and getAggregate as the grid, so KPIs and charts describe the same source; refreshKey re-runs the aggregates after a write.

faq.question: Can users edit the dashboard?
faq.answer: Not in this component; the spec is authored in code. It is meant as a data view over an entity, and the Studio designer is where layouts are edited visually.
